title: Hardcoded Secrets
description: Hardcoded secrets are credentials or security tokens embedded in source or configuration artifacts, where repository or artifact access may expose them.
indicators: API key or token assigned a literal value
private key or credential checked into version control
prevention: Load secrets from an approved secret-management mechanism at runtime.
Revoke and rotate exposed credentials and remove them from repository history where feasible.
Use scoped, short-lived credentials and prevent secrets from entering logs or build artifacts.
source: OWASP Top 10:2025 A07 Authentication Failures (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A07_2025-Authentication_Failures/); OWASP Top 10:2025 A02 Security Misconfiguration (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A02_2025-Security_Misconfiguration/); OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Secrets_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html); MITRE CWE-798 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html)
